name: How long does a typical outdoor pizza oven installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical outdoor pizza oven installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for an outdoor pizza oven varies based on the type of oven and site preparation required. A pre-fabricated oven installation might take a few days to a week, assuming the site is ready. Custom-built ovens or those requiring extensive base construction, utility lines (gas/electric), or landscape modifications could take several weeks. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes a few days for pre-fabricated ovens and several weeks for custom builds, depending on site preparation and complexity.
